parity: Every archived word and all old trace fields must equal the immediate control after removing only trace.stressPattern. No RNG, policy, sampling, weight or rejection change is permitted.
historicalAvailability: Pinned detached control has exact labels for five domains; after-primary and after-explicit-secondary labels and all assignment origins/draw details are unavailable. No reconstruction from final labels.
primaryAcceptance: All candidate records pass independent decision-to-event replay, exact assignment/event bijection, backward-origin/snapshot validation, actual root-to-word geometry and final phones/labels. All scheduled raw draws pass source/artifact/shard/order/count verification and parity.
descriptiveOutcomes: Full P/S/U pattern counts per domain, with stream totals and resolved morphology (bare/prefixed/suffixed/both) crossed with final syllable-count strata
Ordered adjacent marked pairs including PP, PS, SP, SS
Signed secondary distance to each primary; no-primary separate
Declared nuclear metadata per domain; root observed operational policy strata
Executed stress draws, rhythmic skip/gate outcomes and morphology effects
interpretation: Representation proxies only, with known unmarked labels distinct from absent evidence. No desired adjacency-rate decrease, metrical feet, acoustic duration/prominence, naturalness or human quality gain is claimed. Only the returned attempt is observed.
witnessPolicy: First complete candidate per stream, first each morphology status, first each boundary adjacent-label category with its complete origin events, first lexical nucleus change and first surface nucleus change; at most one witness per category per stream, selected in raw draw order.
sourceFingerprint: Before formal capture, declare SHA-256 digest of the canonical ordered source snapshot produced by sourceSnapshot; pass that exact digest to analyze. The report pins these source bytes and rejects changes during analysis. Existing frozen evaluator and detachment tools are not edited.
